scope: Retrospective research alternative: preserve or partially retain country-specific origin offsets from a pooled GDP/governance anchor; use a separately estimated within-country GDP slope for projected change. Frozen original model, defaults and evaluation remain untouched.
knownPriorInformation: Original model had a published aggregate miss. No held-out country outcomes, model predictions or scores may be read during this entry development. Selection among five methods after scoring is exploratory.

outcomes.wellbeing: WHR Cantril ladder 0–10 in pinned training panel; original frozen outcome for external scoring
outcomes.gdp: World Bank GDP per person constant-2015 USD; cumulative growth errors use origin GDP denominator

cohort.rule: Exactly frozen origin countries, with no outcome-based deletion; all valid training background countries enter fits. Internal fold origins use only paired valid outcomes in that fold origin year, without conditioning on later outcomes.

excluded.reason: Missing historical population, gini, ge, rl, cc

equations.pooledAnchor: Fit OLS y_it = a + b_between ln(g_it) + c governance_i using all valid paired rows in fold training years; ladder units 0–10. No year effects, population weighting, feature standardization or interactions.
equations.withinSlope: b_within = sum_i,t[(ln(g_it)-mean_i ln(g))*(y_it-mean_i y)] / sum_i,t[(ln(g_it)-mean_i ln(g))^2], with both country means computed solely from paired fold training rows; no year effects. Zero denominator <= 1e-12 means slope 0.
equations.originOffset: A_i0 = a+b_between ln(g_i0)+c governance_i; e_i0=y_i0-A_i0. Offset is observed origin residual, not claimed equilibrium or causal effect.
equations.gdpRates: For each country, r_i is mean annual log growth across consecutive-year valid paired training observations. r_pool is arithmetic mean of all such log-growth observations. No local transition means r_i=r_pool; no global transition means r_pool=0. Candidate raw rate is 0 (persistence), r_pool (pooled), 0.5*r_i+0.5*r_pool (half-local), or r_i (local). Clip raw rate to [-0.10,0.10], counting clips.
equations.gdpForecast: ln(g_i,h)=ln(g_i0)+r_i_selected*sum_{k=1..h}(0.9^(k-1)). Fixed damping 0.9; no future covariate inputs.
equations.ladderTarget: T_i,h=A_i0+w*e_i0+b_within*(ln(g_i,h)-ln(g_i0)). Governance stays fixed at frozen 2015 value. w=0 challenges offset hypothesis via common anchor; w=1 keeps full country origin offset.
equations.ladderRecursion: y_i,0=observed origin ladder; raw_y_i,h=(1-lambda)*y_i,h-1+lambda*T_i,h; y_i,h=clamp(raw_y_i,h,0,10) each annual step. Report every ladder cap and raw/output ranges. lambda=0 is exact ladder persistence.

candidateGrid.duplicateRule: All 12 labels are reported; three lambda=0 labels produce identical ladder persistence. No further candidates or hidden tuning.

fittedQuantities: Pooled and each country annual log GDP growth
GDP candidate then ladder candidate selected by declared internal loss

internalValidation.temporalRule: Each fold fit, rates, country means and fallback values see only years <= fold origin. Predictions for both outcomes are forecast covariates; validation-year GDP cannot drive ladder forecasts. Validation only reads 2017–2018 rows from train.json after prediction.
internalValidation.selection: Stage 1 select GDP mode using mean of horizon-specific GDP MAEs over horizons 1 and 2, with each horizon weighted one half. Stage 2 select ladder (w,lambda) using the same equal-horizon ladder MAE with Stage-1 GDP mode fixed. Within each horizon all available country/fold rows equally weighted. GDP and ladder scoring masks fixed for all candidates. All candidates and horizon denominators published.
internalValidation.tieRule: Loss ties within 1e-12 resolved by registration enumeration order: GDP persistence, pooled, half-local, local; ladder offset weights 1,0.5,0 outer loop and lambda 0,0.1,0.25,1 inner loop. Thus prefer full offset retention and slower adjustment on exact ties.
internalValidation.emptyRule: If either horizon has no scoreable observations, fail; do not switch criterion.
internalValidation.limitations: Only two forecast origins, three country-year validation blocks and maximum 2-year horizon. Countries and 2018 targets recur; no independent-country validation. Reusing validation for two-stage selection makes selected internal losses optimistic. Cannot validate 7-year dynamics or exogenous shocks.

missingness: Only existing paired training observations enter all model fits/rates; do not fill gaps. Missing local growth uses training pooled rate. Singular pooled OLS (pivot magnitude <1e-12) falls back to training mean ladder with zero slopes and records fallback. Invalid/out-of-range/future-dated input fails closed. No future feature imputation or cohort deletion.
transformations: Natural log of finite positive GDP; ladder remains 0–10. GDP annual log rate clipped [-0.10,0.10] and ladder annual forecast clamped [0,10], with exact counts. No other caps, smoothing, winsorization or coefficient restrictions. Forecast nonfiniteness fails.
forecastCovariates: Origin GDP projected with selected train-only rate/damping; frozen historical governance. No external numeric feature extension.
baseline: Each country’s origin ladder and GDP persist over all horizons; original controller scorer uses identical per-outcome masks.
primaryMetric: 2025 endpoint ladder MAE and model minus persistence MAE, equally weighted observed countries.
secondaryMetrics: Every horizon 2019–2025 ladder MAE/RMSE/bias and difference versus persistence
Pooled country-year ladder MAE/RMSE/bias with denominators
GDP cumulative-growth percentage-point MAE/RMSE/bias relative to origin GDP
Origin income quartiles formed by sorting (gdp,id), group floor(index*4/N); identical masks
Coverage, exclusions, forecast ranges and cap counts
diagnostics: Training-only pooled residual lag correlation and within-vs-between GDP slopes are descriptive. Report all offset/adjustment validation ablations to challenge anchor diagnosis; do not infer causal mechanism or global equilibrium from residual persistence.
emptyOrUndefinedMetrics: null with reason, never zero success
integrityGates: Protocol commit precedes any fit or validation execution
Exactly 100 countries x 7 years; 700 finite rows, GDP >0
Training reject observations after 2018; fold fits reject years after fold origin
Future observation perturbation cannot enter fold fit or forecast
Freeze all outputs before any external scoring; one controller invocation after all family and long-run freezes
vintageLimit: Training observations are later-vintage revised data, not an archived 2018 publication set. Country effects can be measurement error or omitted time-varying variables. Four annual observations cannot identify equilibrium or long-run convergence.
prohibited: Read heldout outcomes/predictions/scores or other agent outputs before freeze
Read full hindcast panel or raw future outcomes/features
Overwrite production/default models or old frozen artifacts

references.title: Bell & Jones (2015), Explaining Fixed Effects
references.use: Separate within-entity and between-entity relationships; does not establish prediction accuracy or justify assuming fixed effects automatically superior.

references.title: Liu, Moon & Schorfheide (2017), Forecasting with Dynamic Panel Data Models
references.use: Short-panel forecasting may benefit from shrinkage of heterogeneous coefficients. Our small deterministic grid is not their empirical Bayes estimator.

references.title: Hyndman & Athanasopoulos, Forecasting: Principles and Practice, temporal cross-validation
references.use: Forecast origins train strictly before targets; multi-horizon validation matters.
